files.document_title: Targa Resources Corp. Investor Presentation, August 2026, page 11, Targa's Permian Intra-Basin Residue System
files.fetch_route: curl_cffi browser impersonation through scripts/fetch.py logic (plain curl was refused with Access Denied)
files.what_it_shows: A schematic of Targa's Delaware and Midland residue pipelines, with dashed lines for lines in progress. It shows the Bull Run extension (43 miles), Buffalo Run and Forza, not Bull Run II. It predates the August 18 announcement of Bull Run II and the plant sites are not named.

files.document_title: Targa Investor Presentation, August 2026, page 11 rendered
files.what_it_shows: The same schematic as a picture. No roads, towns or counties, so it cannot be georeferenced.

searched: The Targa press release of August 18, 2026, which gives a roughly 70 mile line from the new Delaware plants to the Waha Hub, supported by take or pay commitments, in service in the first half of 2028
The pgjonline and Oil and Gas Journal stories named as seeds, both text only
Targa's August 2026 investor presentation, read for any Bull Run II map

Texas Railroad Commission public GIS pipeline layer, queried for Targa Bull Run and residue features (only existing Targa San Andres Gas Utility lines in Yoakum County came back; a line announced in August 2026 has no permit shown yet)
Web search for the sites of the Wrangler, Ranger and Ranger II plants and for a Bull Run II route (none found)
The oilandgaswatch record has no attached documents
notes: No public route map for Bull Run II was found. The only endpoint named is the Waha Hub; the three new Delaware plants (Wrangler, Ranger and Ranger II) have no county or location in any source I could open. The Targa August 2026 presentation is dated before the announcement, so its map shows the existing Bull Run extension of about 43 miles, not this line. East and Daley describes Bull Run as extended by 43 miles to Waha, which may be the earlier phase and should not be confused with the new 70 mile line. A later Targa presentation, such as the third quarter 2026 earnings deck due November 5, 2026, may carry a map. The Targa file server refuses plain curl, so the presentation was fetched through the browser impersonation route. The URL checker got an HTTP 403 from the Targa file server for the presentation URL, but the browser impersonation route read it fine and the file was saved.
